I am a veterinarian and Ph.D. student at Seoul National University, working at the
intersection of statistics and biomedicine. My current research focuses on
single-nucleus RNA sequencing analysis in a mouse model of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC).

## Research Interests

- Statistical genomics and single-cell transcriptomics
- Machine learning and causal inference for biomedical data
- Multi-modal data integration for precision medicine

## Education

- **Ph.D. student**, Veterinary Medicine · Seoul National University · 2024 – present
- **DVM**, Veterinary Medicine · Seoul National University · 2014 – 2021

## Experience

- **Veterinary Officer**, Republic of Korea Air Force · 2021 – 2024

## Coursework

- **Theory:** Statistical Theory, Probability Theory, Real and Multivariate Analysis
- **Methods:** Machine Learning and Deep Learning for Data Science, Statistical Machine Learning, Statistical Computing
- **Applications:** Biostatistics, Genomic and Clinical Data Analysis, Clinical Genomic Medicine, Causal Inference
